source_scope: Closed fictional cave mission; document and clause IDs are visible source references.

output_contract.worldIds: Generated identifiers are arbitrary; compare each world by its frame transform and directed passage/affordance structure.
output_contract.nodeIds: Generated policy node IDs are arbitrary; compare rooted policy behavior and branch coverage.
output_contract.sourceIds: Keep source IDs and landmark identifiers exactly as supplied; A/B are local labels and EW/WW are global labels.
output_contract.ordering: Edge endpoints and action transitions are directed; world sets, independent evidence assertions and observation outcome collections are unordered.
output_contract.unknown: Unknown frame sign is an explicit set of alternatives; unknown and blocked/nonexistent passages remain distinct.
